subject: Maths
central_question: How can we describe, compare, measure, draw, and classify the basic objects of plane geometry?
in_scope_units: 2.11 Types of Angles by Degree Measure

known_pitfalls.claim: Longer arms make a larger angle.
known_pitfalls.correction: Angle size depends on the amount of turn, not arm length.

known_pitfalls.claim: Ray OA can always be renamed AO.
known_pitfalls.correction: The first letter names the starting point, so the rays differ.

known_pitfalls.claim: Every angle at P can be called ∠P.
known_pitfalls.correction: Use three letters when more than one angle has vertex P.

recommended_example_progression: Name points, segments, rays, and angles in Sections 2.1–2.5.
Compare angles by superimposition in Section 2.6.
Obtain right angles through folding in Section 2.8.
Measure with unlabelled and labelled protractors in Section 2.9.
Use clock, drawing, and classification tasks in Sections 2.10–2.11.
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: Use the Figure it Out and Let's Explore tasks through Sections 2.1–2.11, including the final pages 52–54.
